_provenance: Registry-derived label: values are what Brreg/the frozen universe manifest authoritatively record for this company. Included to make the fixture set representative of the ~89% of companies with NO website on file -- the case the original four website-bearing fixtures never exercised. Note these registry fields are authoritative-by-construction (the pipeline reads the same source), so they test wiring and regressions, not discovery; expected_legal_name and the absence of official_site are the genuinely independent signals here.
